Messages.Author: Tom Wylie
Messages.Body:
Ian <iwarford@undergrad.math.uwaterloo.ca> wrote:
>ion--if I have two investments out, can I get blood off them both in on turn.

No.  You give up a master action to take a blood off of "the" Investment,
namely the one you take the counter off of.
